cohort: 40 women with incidentally diagnosed Mullerian anomalies during Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) at a hospital in India between October 2017 and December 2022.
finding: Among 2186 LSCS patients, 40 (1.83%) had incidentally diagnosed Mullerian anomalies, with septate uterus being the most common (35%), and common foetal complications included preterm birth (25%) and low birth weight (37.5%).
mod_finding: Malpresentation was the most common indication for caesarean section, noted in 55% of patients with Mullerian anomalies.
